model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.9 r1 — Process Energy
notes: v7.7.9: ore mining, regolith extraction, energy-resource extraction and capital-goods production draw energy from their colony allocator (one energy_consumer node, model/nodes/process-energy.json): requests read a smoothed signal of the planned rate (a same-step request closes an algebraic loop through the allocator), and energy-sector own use is served first. Planet v1 P3 is 14/2/1/0 - only shared transport stays an exception. See docs/tasks/026-process-energy/.
Modes 0-45 reproduce v7.7.8 r1 exactly (Process Energy Enabled = 0); Mode 46 baseline (planet energy demand +10.6 %), Mode 47 transport surge with a deeper B energy shortage but no fuel collapse.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
